newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL rubber closes mixed after Tokyo's uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: KL rubber closes mixed after Tokyo's uncertainty.

text.p: Rubber prices in Malaysia closed mixed after a fairly thin trading day, with uncertainty in Tokyo market and an absence of consumers demand affecting sentiment, dealers said.

There was continued covering interest from local dealers and some Europeans buyers. "The market hardly see any significant business with most Europeans having met their requirements," a dealer said. There was no news whether South Korea did buy after inquiries for nearby SMR grades
Sellers were offering SMR CV at 326 cents, SMR L at 305, SMR 20 at 256 and latex at 222 latex prices.
Some traders said latex busines was also slow with consumers checking prices for nearby positions.
Expectation of dry weather in Indonesia and uncertainty in the Japanese market also cautioned buyers.
"The market is expected to drift at around current levels," a dealer said. He added that producers are also unwilling to sell actively in anticipation of higher levels in long term.
At the close, July RSS1 buyer closed unchanged at 282 cents ($1.12) a kg and July SMR 20 buyer was down half a cent at 257 cents.
